function.name: update_customer_phone
function.description: Update an existing customer's phone number. Use this when a caller wants to change or correct their contact phone number AFTER they have already been registered. Do NOT use this for new customers - use register_new_customer instead.

customer_id.description: The existing customer's ID from the system

new_phone_number.description: The new phone number the customer wants to use (E.164 format, e.g. +15551234567)

old_phone_number.description: The customer's current phone number on file (E.164 format, e.g. +15551234567)
